purpose: Sync points with the parallel backend lane. DTOs are typed locally in web/src/console/evaluation/evaluationApi.ts until backend/openapi + clients regenerate; the shared capability contract is authoritative and any divergence is a defect to reconcile at consolidation.
assumptions_beyond_contract: EvaluationCyclePage / EvaluationTaskPage use the SalesListingPage shape {items, limit, offset, total}
EvaluationTaskSummary fields assumed: subject_id, cycle_id, cycle_name, period_label, due_date, kind, employee_id, employee_name
Cycle transition POSTs (open/start-calibration/finalize/archive) and POST /cycles return EvaluationCycleDetail
POST /subjects and POST /subjects/{id}/calibrate and PUT /subjects/{id}/goals return EvaluationSubjectDetail
SaveEvaluationReviewRequest = {grade?, note?, evidence_links[{object_kind, object_ref, label, sort_order}]}
EvaluationPreflightReport = {next_transition: stage|null, blockers: string[], advisories: string[]}; blocker/advisory strings rendered verbatim
review kind path segment is lowercase (self|manager)
cross_module_calls: GET /api/v1/users?limit=100 (typed, generated client) — manager picker, first page only
